notes: Requested network context is Sepolia (11155111); chainId is not a manifest key. The required PoolManager and IMD literals are Ethereum mainnet addresses. Both had empty code on Sepolia when checked on 2026-10-07. This manifest can be constructed without those external contracts but is not an operational Sepolia fee pipeline: process rejects unavailable dependencies or an uninitialized IMD pool before allocating ETH. Do not send funds there. Ethereum mainnet is the real manual deployment target. ImdoHook and ImdoClaim are script-only and absent from contracts. Only backward contract references are supported, so claim, regenSafe, offsetsSafe and opsWallet use $owner here. In this manifest the owner is the only stakeFor caller and REGEN custodian; a later ImdoClaim cannot replace that immutable caller. The full manual deployment is a separate fresh deployment using script/DeployImdo.s.sol, which predicts the claim address before creating staking and verifies dependency code and IMD pool liquidity. Do not combine its 890 million LP / 110 million claim allocation with the factory allocation: the factory applies its own supply allocation and initialization-only pool guard. The manifest pool has native ETH, admission fee 3000, spacing 60 and nominal price 2^96; effective factory price and fee follow network policy. Only the separate manual hooked PoolKey charges the requested ETH fee. Treasury buys IMD from fee 10000, spacing 200, no-hook pool; max buy 1 ETH, slippage 300 bps, cooldown 600 seconds. Newly processed ETH pays a 50 bps keeper bounty and the remainder splits 1000/2500/2500/4000 bps to operations, ecological-credit retirement, REGEN and IMD. Processing cap is maxEthPerBuy * 10000^2 / (4000 * 9950); excess ETH remains unsplit. REGEN accrual is capped at 0.5 ETH per timestamp/7-day epoch, with bounds 0.05 to 5 ETH; only regenSafe can change the cap. Overflow funds IMD in the same call. Failed notifications stay pending and retries do not consume the new epoch cap or earn another bounty. Operations and offsets pull their own allocations. Failed keeper payouts can be pulled to a chosen recipient. IMD retries halve to 1 gwei, without rerouting; a deterministic seven-day rational decay of the sqrt-price checkpoint permits recovery from stale prices while spot remains a floor. Stakers lock each deposit for 24 hours and receive IMD plus lifetime ETH-denominated REGEN credits; claim and exit never pay ETH. Only regenSafe withdraws notified REGEN ETH for off-chain purchases and distribution. No owner, upgrades or arbitrary withdrawal on staking/treasury. See README and docs/REVIEW.md for custody assumptions, reproduction evidence and deployment responsibilities.
